# SCRUM-28 - Review and Update Equipment Request

| | |
|---|---|
| **Epic** | SCRUM-10 - Equipment Management |
| **Priority** | Highest |
| **Story points** | 3 |
| **Status in Jira** | To Do|
| **Sprint** | Backlog |
| **Jira** | https://smu-spm-group7.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-28 |

---

- **User Story:** As a Technical Support Staff member, I want to review equipment requests and update them as arrangements are made, so that Event Coordinators know the exact status of their requests.
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - Given I am Technical Support Staff, when I view pending requests, then I can see all equipment details and technical requirements.
- Given I am reviewing a request, when I make arrangements, then I can update the request status from “In Review” to "Approved" or "Rejected".
- Given I am updating a request, when the requested equipment is unavailable, then I can manually select alternative available equipment from the system inventory to suggest to the Event Coordinator.
- Given I update a request, when I save changes, then the system automatically sends a notification to the Event Coordinator.
- Given I view a request, then I can see a chronological history log of all updates made.



Functionality Area: Equipment Request Management
